question: When Brahmaputra enters Arunachal Pradesh, India, it is called _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dihang**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brahmaputra **is known as **Dihang **in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• The Brahmaputra enters India from the west of Sadiya town in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• Brahmaputra is known as **Jamuna **in Bangladesh.
 
• Major tributaries of Brahmaputra are Teesta, Lohit, **Dibang** and Subansiri.
 
• The largest tributary of Brahmaputra is Subansiri.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Tsangpo**

 
• The **Yarlung Tsangpo River** is the largest major river in the world. It is the longest river in Tibet Autonomous Region, China.
 
• Downstream from Arunachal Pradesh, the river widens and after reaching Assam, the river is known as the Brahmaputra.
 
• The river has been called the** "Everest of rivers"** due to its extreme river conditions.

**Lohit**

 
• Lohit River is a major river located on the border of** India and China.**
 
• This river is a tributary of the Yarlung Tsangpo River in Tibet.
 
• This river flows through the Arunachal Pradesh state of India.
 
• The length of Lohit River is approximately 2,000 kilometers.

**Jamuna**

 
• ​It is one of the** three main rivers of Bangladesh.** It is the main stream of the** Brahmaputra river flowing from India to Bangladesh.**
 
• It flows through the northern part of Bangladesh. Jamuna River is an important water source for Bangladesh.
 
• It is used for irrigation, power generation and transportation. Jamuna River is also an important livelihood source for the people of Bangladesh.
